title: PodCow Daily News Edmonton: Friday, September 18, 2026
summary_html: Today's briefing highlights the heartening rescue of missing Alberta children located safely in British Columbia, alongside a major shift in Manitoba's seasonal time-keeping policies. Internationally, geopolitics dominate the headlines with a newly brokered US-Denmark deal over Greenland and intensifying concerns over Russian hybrid threats in Europe.

title: PodCow Daily News Edmonton: Thursday, September 17, 2026
summary_html: Edmonton marks a high-intensity transition today as new head coach Mike Babcock launches rigorous Oilers training camp practices while Prairie farmers grapple with widespread harvest delays. On the international stage, Prime Minister Mark Carney welcomed an unprecedented EU proposal for Canadian associate membership, even as UN experts released a report alleging U.S. war crimes in Iran.
